text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Three car bombs kill 11 people in Algiers.
- Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf visits Canada and Cuba after a tour to Africa and Europe.
- Bomb explosion kills seven in Saida.
- Air Algerie may resume its flight to Paris airport on April 12.
- Three bomb explosions rock Algiers after a two-month lull.
- Workers' union negotiates with the government a plan to bail out 17 money losing enterprises slated for closure.
- The security forces tighten security in Algiers's Casbah.
- Four die in bomb explosions in Algiers.
